notes: Format Premiere - Coruscant: the objective Plead My Case To The Senate and the Senate cards (Coruscant: Galactic Senate, Senator Palpatine, Supreme Chancellor Valorum, Mas Amedda etc.) are from the Coruscant set.

Starting (7) as posted: Plead My Case To The Senate / Sanity And Compassion, Coruscant: Galactic Senate, Naboo: Theed Palace Throne Room, Heading For The Medical Frigate ('HFTMF'), Insurrection & •Aim High, Squadron Assignments ('Squad Ass.') and Your Insight Serves You Well & •Staging Areas; these count toward the 60.
Posted 'Palpy' in this Light senate deck dested Senator Palpatine (the Light Coruscant senator), not the Dark Emperor Palpatine.
Posted 'Proficiency' under Effects dested the Effect Lightsaber Proficiency (the deck runs Luke's and Qui-Gon's lightsabers); Blaster Proficiency is an Interrupt.

Posted 'Security Route' dested Secure Route; 'Dash' (under Characters) dested Dash Rendar; 'Theed Palace DB' dested Naboo: Theed Palace Docking Bay; 'Forest' and 'Naboo' are the generic Forest site and Naboo system.
The Effects header says (5) but four effects are named; the list totals 60 as published.

The author calls this a revision of his Naboo Celebration posted the day before, with mains instead of Gungans. The strategy lists later changes (DS2 Wedge, Queen's Royal Starship, Ric Olie, We Wish To Board At Once, Reveal Ourselves To The Jedi); the list is kept as posted.
